claim: Let \(P_{31}\) be the Paley tournament on \(\mathbb Z/31\mathbb Z\), oriented by \(i\to j\) exactly when \(j-i\) is a nonzero quadratic residue modulo \(31\). Then its directed flag complex, equivalently its acyclic complex, has exact homotopy type \[\operatorname{dFl}(P_{31})\simeq\bigvee^{960}S^4.\]
integrity: All finite claims are regenerated by the included standard-library verifier. The exact determinant and modular-rank argument certify the integral Smith conclusion. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the Paley tournament of order 31; no classification of all order-31 doubly regular tournaments or all-order Paley theorem is claimed. Literature novelty has residual bibliographic risk.
title: Exact homotopy type of the directed flag complex of the Paley tournament on \(31\) vertices
